text: Really sorry to bother you at this hour, I know you must be busy and it's probably nothing. My son is 3 and he's been a bit under the weather since yesterday, his temperature was 37.9 when I checked about twenty minutes ago. When I was changing him into his pyjamas I noticed some little spots on his chest and a few on his arms, tiny ones like pinpricks, kind of purply red. I remembered reading somewhere about pressing a glass on them so I got one from the kitchen and pressed it on and they didn't fade at all, I could still see every single one through the side of the glass. I did it again on his arm in case I'd done it wrong and same thing. I don't want to overreact or waste anyone's time, my partner says I always worry too much, but I thought I'd better ask someone who actually knows. Sorry again
